hunks.baseline: *There’d been so much going on.*
hunks.sol: *So much had happened.*

hunks.baseline: “Y-You… Benefactor. No, Pavilion Master. Are you hurt anywhere?”
hunks.sol: “B-Benefactor. No, Pavilion Master. Is there anywhere you *aren’t* hurt?”

hunks.baseline: “N-No, that’s not it. I misspoke. What I mean is…”
hunks.sol: “N-No, that came out wrong. What I mean is…”

hunks.baseline: “You’re asking if I’m hurt?”
hunks.sol: “You’re asking if I’m hurt anywhere?”

hunks.baseline: The Divine Physician had come closer without my noticing. He chuckled warmly.
hunks.sol: The Divine Physician had come closer without my noticing. He chuckled.

hunks.baseline: What on earth was I supposed to say in this situation?
hunks.sol: What on earth was I supposed to say to that?

hunks.baseline: I felt strangely awkward and was frantically searching for something to say when a shadow suddenly fell over me. At the same time, something damp touched the crown of my head.
hunks.sol: I felt strangely awkward and was scrambling for an answer when a shadow fell over my head. Something damp touched my scalp.

hunks.baseline: For an instant, I thought rain was leaking through the ceiling. That was before I heard the rough breathing behind me and felt the sticky saliva.
hunks.sol: For an instant, I thought rain was leaking through the ceiling. Then I heard the rough breathing behind me and felt the sticky saliva.

hunks.baseline: “Taishan is very, very happy and glad to see the Pavilion Master again.”
hunks.sol: “Taishan is very very happy and glad to see the Pavilion Master again.”

hunks.baseline: Was this lunatic for real? Look how fast he was talking.
hunks.sol: Was this lunatic for real? Listen to how fast he was talking.

hunks.baseline: “Taishan has finished preparing everything to help the Pavilion Master just give the order.”
hunks.sol: “Taishan is ready to help the Pavilion Master just give the order.”

hunks.baseline: He’d clearly finished preparing to eat five-spice pork, so I gave the order in a voice drained of all hope.
hunks.sol: He was clearly ready to eat five-spice pork, so I gave the order in a voice drained of all hope.

hunks.baseline: I watched the horrific scene through half-lidded eyes, then suddenly remembered someone I’d forgotten.
hunks.sol: I watched the horrific scene with glazed eyes, then remembered someone I’d forgotten.

hunks.baseline: Namho came clomping down the stairs, one hand on his lower back, his face gloomy.
hunks.sol: Namho came shuffling down the stairs, one hand on his lower back, his face gloomy.

hunks.baseline: “Palace privy or not, the place might as well have been greased. I was hanging on to a ceiling beam when my strength gave out.”
hunks.sol: “It’s the imperial palace, so I suppose they keep even the privies well greased. I was hanging on to a ceiling beam when my strength gave out.”

hunks.baseline: “The ceiling beam? Not the floor?”
hunks.sol: “A ceiling beam? Not the floor?”

hunks.baseline: The Divine Physician whispered to me as I stared at him in confusion.
hunks.sol: As I stared at him in confusion, the Divine Physician whispered to me.

hunks.baseline: They knew how dangerous this mission was, and they’d risked their one and only lives. When discussing what to do, I couldn’t hide or lie about a single thing.
hunks.sol: They knew how dangerous this mission was, and they’d risked their one and only lives. I couldn’t hide anything from them or lie to them while we discussed what to do.

hunks.baseline: “I can’t stay away from my post as long as I’d like, so I’ll keep this quick.”
hunks.sol: “I can’t stay away for as long as I’d like, so I’ll keep this quick.”

hunks.baseline: I took a quiet, deep breath and began to speak.
hunks.sol: I took a quiet breath and began to speak.

hunks.baseline: Or, I tried to.
hunks.sol: Or tried to.

hunks.baseline: As soon as I finished pouring out everything that had happened over the past few days, a hushed silence settled over the pavilion.
hunks.sol: As soon as I finished pouring out everything that had happened over the past few days, silence settled over the pavilion.

hunks.baseline: The first to break the silence was Jeok Cheongang.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang was the first to break the silence.

hunks.baseline: “This has gotten one hell of a mess.”
hunks.sol: “What a goddamn mess.”

hunks.baseline: He muttered under his breath, his gaze sinking darkly.
hunks.sol: He muttered under his breath, his gaze darkening.

hunks.baseline: A Great Nation meant a continent. The forces hunkered down in the imperial capital were so powerful that even Jeok Cheongang had to groan.
hunks.sol: A Great Nation meant a continent. The forces gathered in the Imperial Capital were powerful enough to make even Jeok Cheongang groan.

hunks.baseline: And there was another unexpected wild card.
hunks.sol: And there was an unexpected wild card among them.

hunks.baseline: “First, tell us more about that woman called So Gyo. Her appearance, her way of speaking. What weapon she uses and how she moves.”
hunks.sol: “First, tell me more about that woman called So Gyo. Her appearance, her way of speaking. What weapon she uses and how she moves.”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang seemed more wary of So Gyo than anyone else. I told them everything I’d seen and felt myself, even going into detail about her movements during our brief clash.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang seemed more wary of So Gyo than anyone else. I told them everything I’d seen and felt, describing even her movements during our brief clash in detail.

hunks.baseline: “I agree with Senior Jeok. If she’s serving Dark Heaven, she must be one of the demonic or heterodox martial artists. But even among the fiends the Hidden Shadow Pavilion identified during the Great Faction War, women of that caliber were very rare.”
hunks.sol: “I agree with Senior Jeok. If she’s serving Dark Heaven, she must belong to the demonic, heterodox side. But even among the fiends the Hidden Shadow Pavilion identified during the Great Faction War, female masters of that caliber were very rare.”

hunks.baseline: Namho replied in a worried voice, then turned to me.
hunks.sol: Namho turned to me, worry in his voice.

hunks.baseline: I tried to recall what I’d seen, then shook my head.
hunks.sol: I thought back for a moment, then shook my head.

hunks.baseline: The higher one’s martial arts realm, the sharper one’s eye became.
hunks.sol: The deeper one’s martial arts realm, the sharper one’s eye became.

hunks.baseline: No matter how well made a human-skin mask was, it had its limits. And maintaining a disguise technique took a constant supply of internal energy. From what I’d seen, I hadn’t felt the slightest trace of anything like that.
hunks.sol: No matter how well made a human-skin mask was, it had its limits. And maintaining a disguise technique required a constant supply of internal energy. From what I’d seen, there hadn’t been the slightest hint of either.

hunks.baseline: “But we can’t rule out the possibility…”
hunks.sol: “But there’s still a chance—”

hunks.baseline: After cutting Namho off firmly, Jeok Cheongang slowly stroked his chin.
hunks.sol: Having cut Namho off, Jeok Cheongang slowly stroked his chin.

hunks.baseline: “She has a supreme footwork technique and has reached Returning to Simplicity. How old did you say she was?”
hunks.sol: “Footwork of the highest order, and Returning to Simplicity… How old did you say she was?”

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: “To reach that level of martial prowess around thirty is impossi—”
hunks.sol: “To possess that kind of martial prowess at thirty is impossi—”

hunks.baseline: “Why are you looking at me like that while we’re talking?”
hunks.sol: “Why are you looking at me like that in the middle of your sentence?”

hunks.baseline: I kept quiet, chastened, and Jeok Cheongang downed a cup of cold water in one go before clicking his tongue.
hunks.sol: I kept quiet, chastened. Jeok Cheongang downed a cup of cold water in one go and clicked his tongue.

hunks.baseline: “Damn it. It’s one of two things. Either the Lord of Heaven took some once-in-a-millennium prodigy as his Disciple and raised her all this time, or she’s an old monster who’s gone beyond Returning to Simplicity and Returned to Youth.”
hunks.sol: “Damn it. It’s one of two things. Either the Lord of Heaven took a prodigy for the ages as his Disciple and raised her all this time, or she’s an old monster who’s gone beyond Returning to Simplicity and Returned to Youth.”

hunks.baseline: “That’s probably more likely. Even when the world was shaken by the Great Faction War, there were people living in seclusion in remote mountains and valleys. This old man was one of them. There’s no guarantee that the woman called So Gyo wasn’t, too.”
hunks.sol: “That’s more likely. Even when the world was shaken by the Great Faction War, there were people living in seclusion deep in the mountains. This old man was one of them. There’s no guarantee that woman So Gyo wasn’t, too.”

hunks.baseline: Many of the people who’d emerged under Dark Heaven’s command in the present day were old masters from a previous generation, the kind known as fiends. But key figures like the Blood Lord, the Western Heaven Demon Lord, and the Southern Heaven Demon Empress were people the world hadn’t known about at all.
hunks.sol: Many of the people who’d emerged under Dark Heaven’s command in recent years were old masters from a previous generation, the kind known as great fiends. But key figures like the Blood Lord, the Western Heaven Demon Lord, and the Southern Heaven Demon Empress had been unknown to the world.

hunks.baseline: *So it makes sense that So Gyo belongs in the same category.*
hunks.sol: *So Gyo probably belongs in the same category.*

hunks.baseline: But there was something more important than discovering So Gyo’s identity.
hunks.sol: But something mattered more than discovering So Gyo’s identity.

hunks.baseline: No matter how much I thought about it, I couldn’t find an easy answer.
hunks.sol: No matter how much I thought about it, I couldn’t find an answer.

hunks.baseline: “I don’t know. Why did So Gyo go out of her way to make that choice?”
hunks.sol: “I don’t get it. Why did So Gyo go out of her way to make that choice?”

hunks.baseline: “I haven’t been able to understand it either. This may be rude to the Pavilion Master, but… why let a fish that’s already been caught in the net go free?”
hunks.sol: “I haven’t been able to understand it either. This may be rude to you, Pavilion Master, but… why let a fish that’s already been caught in the net go free?”

hunks.baseline: “Perhaps they intend to catch us all at once at the grand banquet that’s coming up.”
hunks.sol: “Perhaps they intend to catch us all at once at the grand banquet.”

hunks.baseline: “If the information got out, it would be a problem for them instead. Now that they’ve made this move, wouldn’t we fight the decisive battle with everything we have?”
hunks.sol: “If word gets out, that only makes things harder for them. Now that they’ve done this, won’t we fight the decisive battle with everything we have?”

hunks.baseline: *If they didn’t have a chance of winning with their forces, they never would’ve dreamed of staging a coup in the first place.*
hunks.sol: *If they didn’t have a chance of winning, they never would’ve dreamed of staging a coup in the first place.*

hunks.baseline: So did the enemy know nothing about this?
hunks.sol: So did the enemy know nothing about them?

hunks.baseline: The current Emperor had gradually reduced the East Depot’s authority as soon as the rebellion succeeded. That was practically proof that he’d kept it in check because he’d been worried about a situation like this.
hunks.sol: The current Emperor had gradually reduced the East Depot’s authority as soon as his rebellion succeeded. That was practically proof that he’d kept it in check because he feared a situation like this.

hunks.baseline: Thorough, calculating, and someone who would always uproot a future source of trouble.
hunks.sol: Thorough and calculating. A man who would always uproot anything that might become a threat to him later.

hunks.baseline: A cold and ruthless ruler. The master of a continent with the power to match.
hunks.sol: A cold, ruthless ruler. The master of a continent, with the power to match.

hunks.baseline: It was hard to explain why someone like that had stood by and let all this happen.
hunks.sol: Why would someone like that stand by and let all this happen?

hunks.baseline: Unless there was only one possibility.
hunks.sol: There was only one explanation I could think of.

hunks.baseline: The air sank heavily around us.
hunks.sol: The air around us grew heavy.
